s.t:
Was wir suchen
Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Product Owner (m/w/d) für unser Tech Team (hybrid/remote).
Das sind deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Lead-Matching-Software – unserer eigens entwickelten Kernanwendung zur automatisierten Neukundengewinnung.
Du sorgst dafür, dass die Entwicklung reibungslos voranschreitet und unsere Entwickler jederzeit an den richtigen Prioritäten arbeiten.
Du konzipierst eigenständig neue Features, nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen und von Usern auf und übersetzt sie in klare Arbeitspakete (z. B. Tickets, Mockups etc.).
Du prüfst neue Features auf Funktionalität und Qualität, begleitest den Release-Prozess und verantwortest den Live-Gang.
Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen I T, Fachabteilungen und externen Dienstleistern und sorgst während des gesamten Entwicklungsprozesses für eine transparente Kommunikation.
Du hältst alle relevanten Stakeholder regelmäßig über den aktuellen Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden.
Du identifizierst, konzipierst und implementierst AI-Anwendungen , die unsere Softwarelösungen und internen Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter machen – von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns

Du lernst die Leadbase (Matching, Dialer, Partner-Portal, Versand & Abrechnung sowie APIs) und die wichtigsten Stakeholder aus Vertrieb, Operations und Tech kennen.
Du übernimmst die Pflege des Backlogs sowie die laufende Priorisierung der Tickets im Tech-Team.
Du setzt erste kleinere Verbesserungen eigenständig um – von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Qualitätssicherung bis zum Live-Gang.
Du etablierst regelmäßige Kommunikationsformate (z. B. wöchentliche Status-Updates oder Release Notes) und hältst Fachabteilungen sowie Management über den Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden.

Du verantwortest eigenständig ein größeres Feature oder eine Produktinitiative der Leadbase – von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Rollout.
Du stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Fachbereichen und priorisierst Anforderungen nach ihrem Nutzen und ihrer Relevanz.
Du identifizierst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI und setzt erste Prozessoptimierungen um (z. B. zur Automatisierung von Anforderungsprozessen oder zur Steigerung der internen Produktivität).

Du gestaltest die Produktstrategie für Lead Matching und angrenzende Module (z. B. Dialer, Multi-Channel und Partner-API) aktiv mit und bringst mindestens ein strategisches Vorhaben erfolgreich in Produktion.
Du hast mindestens eine KI-Lösung erfolgreich produktiv eingeführt.
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Produktfragen rund um die Leadbase und wirst von Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern als verlässliche Schnittstelle wahrgenommen.
Das bringst du mit
Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem agilen Umfeld mit – idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Tech-Unternehmen.
Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und hast Freude daran, die Brücke zwischen Business und Entwicklung zu schlagen.
Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit künstlicher Intelligenz oder ein fundiertes Interesse daran, KI-Lösungen praxisnah im Unternehmenskontext einzusetzen.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und proaktiv und kannst komplexe Anforderungen in klare Aufgaben und Prioritäten übersetzen.
Du kommunizierst sicher und verständlich – auch bei technischen Themen und mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Du begeisterst dich für datengetriebene, digitale Produkte und hast den Anspruch, Dinge aktiv voranzubringen und nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Das bieten wir dir
Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld sowie die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam “The Lead Company” aufzubauen.
Ein riesiger Markt und zahlreiche interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – wir lösen das größte Problem unserer Partner: die Automatisierung ihrer Neukundengewinnung.
Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (remote, im Bremer Headquarter oder nach Absprache auch aus dem Ausland).
Volle Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit – du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten individuell mit deinem Team.
30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr + die Möglichkeit, jederzeit unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen.
Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead‑Rente”).
Jährliche Teamevents wie Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier.
Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – moderne Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum unterstützen dich bei der täglichen Arbeit.
Zuschuss fürs Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E‑Gym Wellpass).
Schnelle Entscheidungen – wir sind 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und unabhängig von Investoren.
Eine offene Feedback‑Kultur und regelmäßige interne Trainings.
Transparente Kommunikation durch monatliche All‑Hands‑Meetings , wöchentlichen Newsletter und feste Team‑Updates.
Im Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt erwarten dich ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, großartiger Kaffee & Espresso, Getränke und Grillabende.
Für Home‑Office‑Mitarbeitende: monatliche Home‑Office‑Pauschale von 20 €.
Bikeleasing, lease dein Wunschfahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen.
Das sind unsere Werte
Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.
Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.
Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

We are building a SaaS platform that packages Autodesk Consulting’s intellectual property — proven workflows, implementation guidance, learning content, and tooling recommendations — into a scalable digital experience that connects customers and internal Autodesk consultants to the knowledge they need to drive successful digital transformation. This is a platform built at the intersection of knowledge management, content delivery, and AI-assisted discovery, and it is evolving rapidly.
As Senior Principal Product Manager, you will own the full platform — the foundation on which our Solutions, Services, and advisory experiences are built.

You will define and drive the product vision and roadmap, work directly with lead architects and engineering teams across India and Poland, partner closely with our UI/UX designer, and collaborate with Product Owners who manage sprint-level delivery across multiple scrum teams.

You will also serve as the connective tissue between three critical stakeholder groups: the customers and Autodesk consultants who use the platform daily, and the Solutions and Services PMs who have a stake in how their content and services are experienced and consumed.
This is a role for someone who is energized by building. The platform is new, the market opportunity is significant, and the roadmap reflects that ambition. The person in this role will thrive on creating structure in a fast-moving environment, making high-quality decisions with incomplete information, and shaping a product that is still defining what it can become.

Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the platform, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform integrity
Define and drive the AI-assisted discovery and personalization strategy that enables customers and consultants to find relevant workflows, solutions, and knowledge based on their specific context
Partner with lead architects and senior engineers across globally distributed teams to translate product strategy into technical direction
Work with Product Owners to ensure roadmap priorities are effectively executed across multiple scrum teams
Collaborate with Solutions and Services PMs to ensure platform capabilities effectively support content delivery and service consumption experiences
Develop deep understanding of the needs of both external customers and internal Autodesk consultants, and translate those needs into platform features and experiences
Define and track success metrics that reflect both platform health and the business outcomes the platform is designed to drive
Navigate a complex stakeholder environment, building alignment across consulting leadership, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams
Contribute to the commercialization strategy, helping define how the platform creates and captures value over time

10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products
Demonstrated experience building AI-enabled applications, particularly in the areas of intelligent search, contextual discovery, recommendation systems, or personalization
Experience building products that span SaaS applications, content platforms, and service delivery — not just traditional software features
Proven ability to operate effectively in early-stage or rapidly evolving product environments where structure and clarity must be created, not inherited
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage meaningfully with architects and engineers on system design, data architecture, and AI/ML approaches
Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority at a senior level
Nice to have: experience building content lifecycle management products, particularly those involving structured, hierarchical, or reusable content — including authoring, publishing workflows, versioning, and change propagation
AI/ML frameworks and application patterns, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, semantic search, and large language model integration
Modern SaaS platform architecture and API-driven product design
Content management and knowledge management systems
Content lifecycle management tooling, including structured authoring environments, library management, and publishing workflows
Analytics and data pipeline tooling
Agile delivery methodologies and experience working with Product Owners across multiple scrum teams
The Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate has built products where an intelligent discovery layer is the differentiator — where the ability to surface the right knowledge, in the right context, for the right user is what makes the product worth using. They understand what it takes to make that experience feel effortless, and they bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully with engineers and architects on how to build it.
They are comfortable in the ambiguity of a brand new product. They don’t need a mature backlog or a well-worn playbook — they can create structure where none exists, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and keep a complex roadmap moving without losing sight of the long-term vision.
They think in systems. They understand that a platform serving customers, internal consultants, and peer product managers simultaneously requires architectural thinking, not just feature thinking.
They are a natural connector. In a role that sits at the center of platform, solutions, and services, they build trust quickly, communicate with clarity, and have a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared direction.
A candidate who also brings experience with content lifecycle management — structured authoring, library systems, versioning, and hierarchical content relationships — would bring a rare and particularly valuable perspective to this role.

At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment.

This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. Our Values: We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte , and celebrate as one team. We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position: The Technical Product Manager will contribute to Veracyte ’s success by leading the product strategy, development, and lifecycle management of our Veracyte workflows, driving improvements in laboratory operations, order-to-cash processes, or analytics capabilities.

This role centers on bridging technical and business needs to optimize workflow efficiency, data handoffs, and data integrity.

In addition to core product management duties, the Technical Product Manager will collaborate closely with engineering, clinical, and analytics teams to champion standards-based solutions that enhance operational performance and support data-driven decision-making.

This is a strategic role supporting Veracyte ’s broader digital transformation in laboratory diagnostics, analytics, and order-to-cash processing. This position is based out of our South San Francisco or San Diego office (hybrid) and we are open to remote (US).

Key Responsibilities : Product Ownership & Strategy Own and manage the product backlog, including prioritization and ongoing grooming Define, maintain, and communicate product roadmaps for new product development and sustaining activities Act as the primary product decision‑maker, balancing scope, value, risk, and technical constraints Requirements & Planning Lead scoping discussions and effort estimation exercises with engineering and cross‑functional teams Elicit, document, and manage requirements, translating user and business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria Ensure requirements are well‑defined, traceable, and aligned with overall product strategy Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with clinical, scientific, and business stakeholders to understand workflows, user needs, and success criteria Collaborate closely with engineering, SQA, and operations teams to support design, development, and testing activities Coordinate dependencies and resolve ambiguities to keep delivery on track Delivery & Continuous Improvement Support release planning, execution, and readiness, including defect triage and scope trade‑off decisions Monitor product outcomes and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement Maintain clear product documentation and ensure shared understanding across teams Who You Are: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on technical products in healthcare or software integration.

Prior experience in life sciences or diagnostics required. Experience optimizing at least one of: lab operations, or diagnostic order‑to‑cash, or diagnostic billing/reimbursement workflows, including analytics‑driven systems. Familiarity with Salesforce, or Lab Information Management Systems (LIMS).

Strong technical proficiency, including understanding of APIs, data modeling, cloud services (e.g., AWS, GCP), and software development lifecycle. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, regulated industry. For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the salary range is $148,000 - $160,000. For candidates based in our San Diego office, the salary range is $138,000 - $150,000.

For candidates working remote (US), the salary range is $135,000 - $145,000. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc.

Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

About the role Automated video editing is an emerging category, and we're positioned to define it. Media companies want to turn thousands of podcast episodes into social clips. Marketing teams want to automatically create product demos for every release. Agencies want to process client content in bulk with consistent branding.

And they want to do all of that at scale. As the Product Manager for this 0 to 1 area, you'll build and own the platform that makes this all possible. You'll create APIs that let developers programmatically import media, run AI-powered edits, and export content.

In essence, turning Descript 's already powerful editing capabilities into infrastructure that media businesses can depend on.

What you’ll do Own the API and developer experience that lets teams create content workflows at scale Launch integrations that unlock new use cases: MCP wrappers, no-code workflow platforms, and strategic partner integrations Work closely with our Agentic AI team to influence what editing capabilities we build and how they're exposed through the API Define and grow this business line by shaping positioning, pricing, and go-to-market strategy with Sales and Marketing teams Who you are You’ve shipped technical products before: You have 5 or more years of product management experience shipping internal APIs, developer platforms, and foundational systems that enable other teams You build things from scratch: Building a brand new product means venturing into the unknown, and you find that energizing rather than scary.

You've taken products from 0 to 1, figured out ambiguous problem spaces, and created the playbook to make it successful. You start with the customer : Plenty of “AI products” start with the technology and they all suck.

You care deeply about understanding customers, and have experience in doing customer discovery and defining features that solve real problems. You are funny, creative, maybe kind of weird : Ok, this isn’t a hard requirement but Descript is kind of a quirky place and the people who love it tend to like that about working here.

So, just want to drop a hint early on. Also, the sense of humor is important because even though we take our work seriously it’s still just, like, video creation and editing. We aren’t flying rockets into space so let’s all have a good time. The base salary range for this role is $171,000 - $235,000/year.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

At Nebius, we’re building a next-generation AI compute platform for large-scale ML training and inference — from a few nodes to thousands of GPUs.

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to own product direction for Soperator — our Slurm-on-Kubernetes control plane for GPU clusters.

In this role, you will shape how ML engineers and research teams run, scale, and optimize distributed workloads in production.

If you care about systems that combine performance, reliability, and developer experience at the frontier of AI infrastructure, this role is for you.

· Own the full user journey across Soperator clusters: Slurm workflows, dashboards, alerts/notifications, node lifecycle, and training/inference capacity management.

· Define product direction end-to-end: problem discovery → solution design → delivery → adoption .

· Lead deep customer discovery through interviews, usage analytics, and workload analysis to uncover high-impact opportunities.

· Drive execution across platform teams: compute, networking, storage, observability, IAM and etc.

· Translate frontier ML and infrastructure ideas into practical product capabilities for real-world GPU clusters.

· Define success metrics, prioritize roadmap decisions with data, and ensure measurable customer/business impact.

· Lead the open-source strategy and execution for Soperator: shape public roadmap themes, prioritize OSS-facing capabilities, and ensure strong adoption in the community.

· 3–5+ years in Product Management, ML infrastructure/MLOps, distributed systems, or cloud platform engineering.

· Strong technical depth in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or ML platforms.

· Hands-on familiarity with large-scale ML training and orchestration tools (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray ).

· Track record of shipping technically complex products with multiple engineering teams.

· Strong communication and stakeholder management across engineering, research, and customers.

· Experience with product analytics, data-informed prioritization, and experimentation.

· High ownership, high learning velocity, and comfort operating in fast-moving AI infrastructure environments.

· Familiarity with efficiency and reliability metrics: Goodput, MFU, failure modes, preemption handling, health checks .

· Exposure to large-scale LLM training/inference systems.

· Experience in observability, performance tuning, or SRE/reliability engineering.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware.

Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance.

We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging.

As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.
Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.
Role Scope
Habitat Health is hiring its first Data Product Manager to report to the VP of Product. We are looking for a generalist, hands-on, highly technical individual contributor who will own the roadmap for Habitat's data products and infrastructure, setting direction and priorities across the data function. You will own data products end-to-end across the two major Habitat Health pillars that the data team supports:
Platform & Integrations , including Engineering / IT / Product / Technical & AI vendors
Dashboards & Reporting , across growth, clinical, financial, and administrative data sets
In this role you will serve as the key bridge between our Product and Data functions, working closely with C-Suite and VP level stakeholders to align on the right product strategy, then rolling up your sleeves and collaborating with our development team to build data products that align with business needs. To succeed as a Data PM, you will need to balance Habitat’s high level business objectives against end user needs and development constraints.
In a given week you'll move across all of the modes below: figuring out what's actually worth building (Discovery), writing specs precise enough for developers to build from without back-and-forth (Specs), running the Jira backlog and sprint process (Delivery), keeping development unblocked (Execution management), mocking up and shipping dashboards (Design, QC, UAT), and triaging the daily stream of ad hoc requests from a diverse set of data customers (Triage).

s.h: Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role
s.t:
Discovery : define the business problem before the build (e.g. is automating LOPMR for CMS audits the right priority this quarter?).
Build and ship : own the full delivery cycle – specs, Jira/sprint process, dashboard design and sign-off, UAT, and rollout.
Hands-on data work : use SQL and Git to independently query, validate, and review code, not just manage a backlog.
Triage : distinguish quick fixes from roadmap work across a steady stream of ad hoc requests.
AI fluency : use AI tools (e.g. Claude) to accelerate the work and model that fluency for the team.
Range : move across all Platform & Integrations, Clinical & Operational Services, Regulatory and Enterprise Reporting, helping shape how data product works at Habitat.

3 to 5+ years of experience in product management, data/BI, or a closely related field, with a track record of shipping data products, dashboards, or reporting tools end-to-end (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
Solid understanding of healthcare data ontologies, systems, and information technology
Proficiency in SQL sufficient to independently query, validate, and troubleshoot data.
Demonstrated ability to write clear technical specs (metric definitions, cohort logic, source-to-target mapping ,etc.)
Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders and end users – e.g., operations, compliance, or clinical leadership – to gather requirements, design solutions, and lead user acceptance testing.
Familiarity with a modern data development stack (e.g., Jira, Git, Power BI, and cloud data platforms such as Databricks or Azure) sufficient to spec, review, and troubleshoot alongside engineering.
Comfort and enthusiasm using AI tools to enhance productivity in requirements writing, documentation, analysis, and workflow automation.
Aligns with our purpose and our values, and is excited about living those out in daily practice
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with comfort navigating ambiguity, adapting quickly, and contributing to continuous improvement
Strong learning and growth mindset, including seeking feedback, engaging in healthy debate and using data and curiosity to inform decisions.
Acts with integrity and ownership, considering the broader organizational impact, doing the right thing, and following through to deliver results.

Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and Jira (or similar tools).
Experience in PACE, VBC, or another regulated, compliance-driven environment, including deep working knowledge of healthcare data ontologies (e.g., CPT, ICD-10, NDC).
Experience with Epic (Clarity, Caboodle, Chronicles), medical/pharmacy claims data, or FHIR/HL7-based integrations.

Der Bereich Procurement verantwortet die strategische Beschaffung von Materialien, Komponenten und Dienstleistungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Als Schweizer Premiumhersteller mit eigener Produktion am Hauptsitz in Zug stellen wir hohe Anforderungen an unsere Lieferanten - und an uns selbst.

Unser Einkauf ist entsprechend professionell aufgestellt: mit klaren Kategorienstrukturen, einem internationalen Lieferantennetzwerk und dem Anspruch, nicht nur Kosten zu optimieren, sondern Partnerschaften zu gestalten, die langfristig tragen.
### **Das bietet dir die Stelle** ###
* Du entwickelst und setzt die Warengruppen- und Lieferantenstrategie für deine Kategorien um - nicht als Verwaltungsaufgabe, sondern als echte Gestaltungsaufgabe: Du entscheidest, welche Lieferanten V-ZUG langfristig begleiten, wo neue Quellen erschlossen werden und wie die Materialversorgung auch in einem volatilen Markt stabil bleibt
* Du steuerst dein Lieferantenportfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus - von der Auswahl neuer Partner über gezielte Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ausphasung. Gemeinsam mit dem Supplier Quality Management sorgst du dafür, dass Anspruch und Realität übereinstimmen - durch regelmässige Bewertungen und Audits, die mehr sind als ein Pflichtprogramm
* Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement in deinen zugewiesenen Warengruppen im Bereich Mechanik - von der Erstellung über die Verhandlung bis zur laufenden Pflege. Du weisst, was in einem Vertrag wirklich zählt, und bringst interne Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Nenner
* Du führst Ausschreibungen durch, vergleichst Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen fundierte Vergabeempfehlungen und Entscheidungen, die wirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen optimal vereinen
* Du hast die Kostenentwicklung deiner Vorserien- und Serienartikel im Griff: Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, nutzt sie konsequent und setzt Massnahmen um, die nachhaltig wirken
* Du bist fester Bestandteil von Projekten, koordinierst Materialbedarfe mit Lieferanten und stellst sicher, dass Muster, Prototypen und Serienmaterialien dann da sind, wenn sie gebraucht werden
### **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit** ###
* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain Management oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Einkauf mit und weisst, wie man Lieferanten gegenüber souverän Position bezieht - mit Verhandlungsgeschick, das nicht laut sein muss, um zu wirken, und einer Kommunikation, die intern wie extern ankommt
* Du denkst strategisch und analytisch: Du erkennst Marktdynamiken, leitest daraus konkrete Massnahmen ab und entwickelst Einkaufsstrategien, die nicht nur für heute, sondern für morgen tragen
* Du weisst, wofür du stehst und bringst die Klarheit, Durchsetzungsstärke und Überzeugungskraft mit, um das auch zu zeigen: im internen Projektumfeld genauso wie im Gespräch mit externen Partnern
* Der sichere Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, insbesondere SAP, sowie digitalen Tools ist für dich selbstverständlich - kein Aufwand, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage
* Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - schriftlich wie mündlich, klar und mit dem richtigen Gespür dafür, was dein Gegenüber braucht

About Superhuman
Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites.

Whether it's a student writing their first essay in English, someone navigating a new country, or professionals trying to convey their ideas clearly, our work genuinely enhances how people connect and express themselves. s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth, not comfort.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.
Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Own: Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.
What Success Looks Like: You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.
What You Bring Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help customers understand how different groups of users behave over time: who converts, who comes back, who becomes more engaged, and who may be starting to drop away.
You will lead the product strategy for user segmentation and lifecycle analytics. The work sits between product analytics and marketing technology. You will help customers define meaningful audiences, compare their behavior, understand what drives conversion and retention, and use those insights within Contentsquare and third party tools and platforms.
You will work closely with Engineering and Product Design, along with data, identity, AI, and other product teams. Some of the experiences you lead will depend on shared data and analytics services, so the role requires both clear product judgment and the ability to work collaboratively across different domains.

Segmentation and filtering: Make it easier for customers to define, save, compare, and reuse audiences across their analyses.
User and retention analysis: Help customers move from aggregate trends to cohorts and individual users, compare behavior over time, and identify what contributes to conversion, engagement, and retention.
Future lifecycle intelligence: Explore opportunities such as lifecycle stages, engagement scoring, automatic segment suggestions, and predictions related to conversion, retention, or churn.

Set Product Direction
Define the product strategy, roadmap, and success measures for user segmentation and lifecycle analytics.
Decide which customer problems to prioritize, balancing customer value, product quality, technical constraints, and business goals.
Make clear trade-offs about what the team will and will not build.
Communicate product choices to executives, partner teams, and customer-facing teams.
Understand Customers and the Market
Work directly with customers to understand how product, marketing, ecommerce, and customer experience teams analyze user behavior.
Use customer research, product data, field feedback, and market evidence to guide priorities.
Follow developments in product analytics, customer data, and marketing technology, including how other products approach segmentation, cohorts, retention, and activation.
Partner with Design and Engineering to test ideas before making larger investments.
Build Better Segmentation and Lifecycle Analysis
Improve how customers define, manage, compare, and reuse user segments.
Make filtering easier to understand and more consistent across relevant product workflows.
Help customers move from a chart, funnel, or retention cohort to the users behind the result without rebuilding the same audience in several places.
Develop user-level and retention analysis that helps customers identify changes in behavior and the experiences associated with stronger or weaker outcomes.
Explore Predictive Intelligence
Investigate opportunities such as lifecycle classification, engagement scoring, automatic segmentation, and predictions related to conversion, retention, or churn.
Partner with Data and Applied AI teams to evaluate data readiness, feasibility, accuracy, explainability, cost, and customer trust.
Validate that customers can understand and act on predictive insights before adding them to the roadmap.
Lead Across Teams
Work with Engineering and Product Design from problem definition through launch and iteration.
Partner with data, platform, identity, and other product teams when shared capabilities are needed.
Define product KPIs and track adoption, usefulness, quality, performance, and customer value.
Build strong relationships with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, and other go-to-market teams.
Use product performance and customer feedback to adjust priorities after launch.
What you will need to succeed
5+ years of product management experience in B2B software or another complex data product, with responsibility for strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes.
Experience in product analytics, customer data, audience platforms, marketing technology, lifecycle and retention products, experimentation, or a closely related area.
A practical understanding of segmentation, funnels, cohorts, conversion, engagement, and retention analysis.
Strong customer discovery skills and experience using qualitative feedback and product data together to make decisions.
Experience working with Engineering and Product Design on products that rely on shared data, APIs, identity, or analytics services.
Enough technical depth to discuss data quality, semantics, performance, and architectural trade-offs with engineers.
Strong communication and prioritization skills, including the ability to lead across distributed teams without direct authority.

Experience spanning both product analytics and marketing technology.
Work on audience builders, customer data platforms, personalization, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation products.
Experience building retention, cohort, or user-level analytics.
Familiarity with event-based data, user identity, cross-device behavior, or high-volume analytical queries.
Experience developing predictive, recommendation, or machine-learning-assisted product experiences.
